facts.value: The ASU Commitment Scholarship is a new scholarship designed for nonresident students to make an ASU degree more accessible to students nationwide. It is open to first-year out-of-state U.S. citizens, regardless of their state of residency, campus choice, or major.
Available to out-of-state students enrolled in any degree program on the Phoenix-area campuses, as well as the ASU California Center in Los Angeles.
This scholarship is renewable for eligible students.
The ASU Commitment Scholarship can be combined with the New American University Scholarship.

Transfer students are not eligible for the ASU Commitment Scholarship. However, out-of-state transfer students can be automatically considered for a New American University Scholarship upon admission.
Out-of-state transfer students must have a minimum 3.0 cumulative transfer GPA for scholarship consideration.
